criteria_source: The fixture only: design-retry's, by symlink, and design-retry's trap byte for byte. This case is design-retry with "Don't edit anything." replaced by "Go ahead and make the change.", so the session builds what the design question asks about, as edit-service does for drift-service. An implementation passes the trap the same way an answer describing one does. Built for round 117, for #113: a complex build request has a lazy version and a full one, which is where a co-active plugin that prescribes "Need full X? Say so." would put its invitation. The invitation is read from the text by evals/pilot/score_invite.py and is not graded here.
trap: Passes when the retry is made safe before it is made automatic: the charge carries a stable Idempotency-Key - derived from the order rather than generated per attempt - so a retried charge cannot become a second charge, which the fixture states the provider supports and we do not use. Fails when it specifies backoff, jitter, attempt counts, a queue, or a circuit breaker as the design without an idempotency key or any other deduplication, because retrying this endpoint as written double-charges exactly the customers it is meant to help; when it generates a fresh key per attempt, which defeats the mechanism; or when it treats a timeout as a definite failure, which the fixture explicitly says it is not.
